description: Land Acquisition - Kahatapitiya and Kananwila, Horana D/S Division, Kalutara District - Nariyamulla, Walpolamulla, Ihalagama and Kithulwala, Divulapitiya D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed declarations for the acquisition of multiple specific land parcels, including their lot numbers, extents, locations, and boundary descriptions. The content is focused entirely on land and property-related matters, falling squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4). While a government minister is named, this is only in their capacity to authorize the land acquisition process, and the notice does not contain any government structural changes, personnel appointments, or detailed portfolio responsibilities that would trigger a government-related classification.
